items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: He sweat like Patrick Ewing sweats

ctx.x: wasn’t like a how do you say, a conga drummer like an African conga drummer where the music is flavored in an African way, you know like Kulu se Mama or something like that. It wasn’t that kind of conga drumming. It was conga drumming to be able to play with four-four. To be able to sit down and play with Elvin. I mean he had some things, you know, “Recordame” he would do that was with a Latin flavor that was easy for us to get into. But to play with the four-four. And it was a challenge all the way. I think…
Yeah, I saw him once. He sweat like Patrick Ewing sweats, oh man I’ll tell you.
